6e3a2ca7: 
This subroutine EXP handles the expansion of selected items from the list.

It first gets the selected item indices from the user and stores them in VALMY(). If no items are selected, it quits.
Then it loops through the selected items, displaying the detailed information for each one.
For certain item types (OP REPORT, DISCHARGE SUMMARY, etc.), it calls EXP1 or EXP2 to handle displaying additional details.
It also handles the case where the user wants to edit the Transcribed Date for a Discharge Summary.
